sentences.text: Zeltornis is an extinct genus of bird belonging to the family Ardeidae, which includes modern herons.
This ancient heron is estimated to have had a wingspan of 2.50 meters.
Scientists believe it was most closely allied to night herons.
The genus was described by Balouet in 1981 based on a single right coracoid bone with the distal part missing.
Zeltornis lived during the Early Miocene epoch.
